state.description: Current output state: `PASS_THROUGH` (input present; outlets powered through from the input, battery idle or charging), `ON_BATTERY` (islanded; outlets powered from battery / solar, isolated from the input), `NO_OUTPUT` (no input and no output), `UNKNOWN`.

mode.description: Requested output mode: `FOLLOW_INPUT` (normal; island automatically only on loss of input) or `ISLAND` (force the device-output island now, running the outlets from battery even with input present).

transfer-time.description: Nameplate input-to-battery switchover time (the UPS ride-through spec).
